name: stm_bishop_pair_advantage
description: The side to move has the bishop pair while the opponent has at most one bishop.
source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_bishop_pair_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = "The side to move has the bishop pair while the opponent has at most one bishop."

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = b.turn
    opp = not stm
    return len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm)) >= 2 and len(b.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp)) <= 1
